summaries.zh: OpenAI、AIRPPU 与 WAN-IFRA 联合推出一个人工智能项目，旨在帮助乌克兰新闻机构提升创新能力、增强韧性，并支持独立新闻报道。该计划聚焦于利用AI技术协助当地媒体应对挑战，维护新闻独立性。
summaries.en: OpenAI, together with AIRPPU and WAN-IFRA, has launched an AI-focused program to support Ukrainian news organizations. The initiative aims to strengthen innovation, resilience, and independent journalism within the country’s media sector.
